english.title: Breach a Domestic Violence Protection Notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were arrested by a constable having breached a Domestic Violence Protection Notice issued on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE ON WHICH THE NOTICE WAS ISSUED..) and are now brought before the court for an application for a Domestic Violence Protection Order in accordance with sections 26 and 27 of the Crime and Security Act 2010
english.legislation: Contrary to section 26 of the Crime and Security Act 2010.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
The above wording is not an offence.
This document is supplied by PNLD for procedural purposes only.

By virtue of section 25(1)(b) of the Crime and Security Act 2010 a constable may arrest a person without warrant if the constable has reasonable grounds for believing that person is in breach of the DVPN.

other.penalty:
Not applicable - this is NOT AN OFFENCE

In spite of the fact that a power of arrest exists for breaching a DVPN, it is NOT an offence

libra.complexpenaltydetails: Not applicable - this is NOT AN OFFENCE
